Filter out non-positive numbers and sort the result. def positives(arr): return sorted([x for x in arr if x > 0])
Count numbers in data greater than t. def how_many_above(data, t): return sum(1 for x in data if x > t)
Filter out numbers less than or equal to 1. def keep_big(arr): return [x for x in arr if x > 1]
Multiply each value in the list by 7. def scaled(vals): return [x * 7 for x in vals]
Add 20 to each number in the list. def offset_all(data): return [x + 20 for x in data]
Remove duplicates from a list while preserving the order of first occurrence. def distinct(seq): return [x for i, x in enumerate(seq) if seq.index(x) == i]
Find the index of the first maximum value in the list. def where_max(data): return data.index(max(data))
Merge two sorted lists into one sorted list. def merge(xs, b): return sorted(xs + b)
Calculate the difference between each pair of consecutive numbers in the list. def steps(items): return [items[i] - items[i-1] for i in range(1, len(items))]
Return the last 2 items or the whole list if shorter. def last_items(nums): return nums[-2:] if len(nums) > 2 else nums
Shift the first element to the end of the list. def rotate_left(values): return values[1:] + values[:1] if values else []
Find the min and max of the list in one line. def low_high(numbers): return (min(numbers), max(numbers))
Find the median of a list by sorting and averaging the middle values. def find_median(xs): import math; return (sorted(xs)[len(xs)//2 - 1] + sorted(xs)[len(xs)//2]) / 2
Convert two lists into a dictionary. def to_dict(labels, values): return {labels[i]: values[i] for i in range(len(labels))}
Split the line into words and return their lengths. def word_lengths(line): return [len(word) for word in line.split()]
Count words by splitting on whitespace. def how_many_words(words): return len(words.split())
Count occurrences of character c in string msg. def char_count(msg, c): return msg.count(c)
Remove all occurrences of character c from string text. def strip_char(text, c): return text.replace(c, '')
Convert phrase to acronym by taking the first letter of each word and joining them. def abbreviate(s): return ''.join(word[0].upper() for word in s.split())
Check if sorted characters of both strings, ignoring case, are equal. def same_letters(w1, b): return sorted(w1.lower()) == sorted(b.lower())
Count characters in a word using a dictionary. def count_chars(word): return {char: word.count(char) for char in set(word)}
Repeat the string msg count times without any separator. def echo(msg, count): return msg * count
Find the first non-repeating character in a string. def non_repeating(t): return next((c for c in t if t.count(c) == 1), None)
Calculate the greatest common divisor of two integers using the Euclidean algorithm. def hcf(m, q): import math; return math.gcd(m, q)
Calculate the factorial of a non-negative integer. def n_factorial(value): import math; return math.factorial(value)
Limit n to the range from low to ceiling inclusive. def limit(n, low, ceiling): return max(low, min(n, ceiling))
Calculate the sum of all integers from 1 to x using the formula for the sum of an arithmetic series. def sum_up_to(x): return int(x * (x + 1) / 2)
Calculate a raised to the power of n using recursion. def pow_int(a, n): return a * pow_int(a, n-1) if n > 0 else 1
Add up the numbers in the list using the built-in sum function. def list_sum(nums): return sum(nums)
Multiply all numbers in the list, or return 1 for an empty list. def multiply_all(arr): return math.prod(arr) if arr else 1
Calculate the average of a list of numbers. def mean_of(arr): return sum(arr) / len(arr)
Find the minimum value in the list. def smallest(seq): return min(seq)
Count even numbers in a list using a generator expression inside the sum function. def count_evens(items): return sum(1 for item in items if item % 2 == 0)
Count numbers in seq strictly greater than cutoff. def num_above(seq, cutoff): return sum(1 for x in seq if x > cutoff)
Filter numbers greater than -1 from the list. def greater_than(nums): return [x for x in nums if x > -1]
Multiply each element in the list by 7. def times_k(data): return [x*7 for x in data]
Add 6 to each number in the list. def offset_all(values): return [x + 6 for x in values]
Apply a lambda to square each number in the list. def squares(nums): return list(map(lambda x: x**2, nums))
Convert each number to its absolute value. def absolutes(numbers): return [abs(x) for x in numbers]
Remove duplicates from a list while preserving the order of first occurrence. def unique(lst): return [x for i, x in enumerate(lst) if lst.index(x) == i]
Find the second largest distinct value in the list. def second_max(arr): import math; return sorted(set(arr), reverse=True)[1]
Find the index of the first occurrence of the largest value in the list. def argmax(vals): return vals.index(max(vals))
Multiply corresponding elements and sum the results. def dot(a, ys): return sum(x*y for x, y in zip(a, ys))
Find common values in two lists and return them sorted. def common(left, right): return sorted(set(x for x in left if x in right))
Merge two sorted lists into one sorted list. def combine_sorted(left, second): return sorted(left + second)
Shift the list left by one position, moving the first item to the end. def shift_left(lst): return lst[1:] + lst[:1]

Find the median of a list by sorting it and averaging the middle values if even. def find_median(seq): import math; return (seq[len(seq)//2] + seq[(len(seq)-1)//2]) / 2 if len(seq) % 2 == 0 else seq[len(seq)//2]
Create a dictionary by zipping keys and values together. def pair_up(keys, vals): return dict(zip(keys, vals))
Count vowels in a string by checking each character. def count_vowels(s): return sum(1 for c in s if c.lower() in 'aeiou')
Reverse the string line by slicing. def reverse(line): return line[::-1]
Split the line into words and return their lengths. def word_sizes(line): return [len(word) for word in line.split()]
Count words by splitting string on whitespace. def word_count(s): return len(s.split())
Count occurrences of ch in line with the count method. def times_seen(line, ch): return line.count(ch)
Remove all occurrences of ch from string. def delete_char(s, c): return s.replace(c, '')
Check if sorted characters of both strings are equal ignoring case. def is_anagram(w1, b): return sorted(w1.lower()) == sorted(b.lower())
Count upper-case letters in a string. def num_capitals(text): return sum(1 for c in text if c.isupper())
Find the first character in the string that appears exactly once. def first_single(line): return next((c for c in line if line.count(c) == 1), None)
Check if k is a prime number by testing divisibility. def check_prime(k): return k > 1 and all(k % i != 0 for i in range(2, int(k**0.5) + 1))
Find the greatest common divisor of two non-negative integers using the Euclidean algorithm. def gcd(p, n): import math; return math.gcd(p, n)
Calculate the Fibonacci number at the given position using recursion. def fibo(value): return value if value <= 1 else fibo(value-1) + fibo(value-2)
Limit v to be between minimum and ceiling inclusive. def limit(v, minimum, ceiling): return max(min(v, ceiling), minimum)
Calculate the sum of all integers from 1 to n using the formula for the sum of an arithmetic series. def sum_to(n): return n * (n + 1) // 2
Convert integer to binary string without '0b' prefix. def as_binary(m): return bin(m)[2:]
Calculate the hypotenuse using the Pythagorean theorem. def hypotenuse(leg1, q): import math; return math.sqrt(leg1**2 + q**2)
Count digits in m using logarithm. def count_digits(m): import math; return int(math.log10(m)) + 1 if m > 0 else 1
